metadata.attribution: OpenFreeMap © OpenMapTiles Data from OpenStreetMap
metadata.license: OpenStreetMap-derived water data: ODbL 1.0; retain contributor attribution and observe the database licence.
metadata.processing: Extracted only water/waterway layers; Multi geometries split into LineString/Polygon parts. Douglas–Peucker in a local metric projection with original ring fallback for disappearing lakes/holes, >15% area change, self-crossings or lost islands. Six decimal coordinate rounding. Exact duplicate geometry removed; adjacent tile fragments intentionally preserved.
metadata.clipping: Features intersect the extraction area but retain full source tile fragments. The renderer must clip them to the Abai region boundary; bbox records actual output geometry extent.
metadata.limitations: Generalized z7 source geometry, not a complete river inventory or navigation chart. Small tributaries omitted by the source at this zoom cannot be restored. No hand-drawn or inferred rivers were substituted.
metadata.tileBufferProcessing: LineString fragments clipped to their true XYZ tile bounds to remove artificial line connections in MVT padding. Polygons retain their source buffer; clip filled water to the region boundary.
